## Load packages

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, limpa, limma, dplyr, tibble, tidyr, purrr, ggplot2, readr, writexl)
here::i_am(
  "02_Differential_Expression/03_Protein_Association/a_script/03_protein_association.qmd"
)
```

## Read proteins and phenotype

The models read `proteins.rds` and carry the blood index as a covariate; the figures and the leg
correlation use `proteins_adjusted.rds`, with the blood effect removed. `phenotype.csv` holds one
row per leg: cross-sectional area (CSA) and echo intensity of vastus lateralis (`vl_`) and rectus
femoris (`rf_`) before and after training, and the total volume load lifted.

```{r read}
stage <- here("02_Differential_Expression", "03_Protein_Association")
proteins <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins.rds"))
targets <- proteins$targets
values <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins_adjusted.rds"))$E
phenotype <- read_csv(here("00_Input", "phenotype.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Pair the samples

`legs` has one row per leg with both samples; `delta_pairs` one row per participant with both
legs.

```{r legs}
legs <- targets |>
  mutate(leg_id = paste(participant, leg, sep = "_")) |>
  select(leg_id, participant, leg, treatment, timepoint, sample_id) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = sample_id) |>
  drop_na(T1, T2) |>
  arrange(participant, treatment)
delta_pairs <- legs |>
  select(participant, treatment, leg_id) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = leg_id) |>
  drop_na(BFR, HLRT)

c(legs = nrow(legs), participants_with_both_legs = nrow(delta_pairs))
```

## Compute the outcomes

Each outcome is one number per leg: post minus pre for CSA and echo, and total volume load in
tonnes. Echo intensity falls as muscle composition improves, so a negative change is favourable.
Treatment comes from the sample table, not the phenotype file.

```{r outcomes}
outcomes <- c("vl_csa", "vl_echo", "rf_csa", "rf_echo", "volume_load_t")
leg_phenotype <- legs |>
  left_join(
    select(phenotype, -treatment),
    by = c("participant", "leg"), relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    vl_csa = vl_csa_post_cm2 - vl_csa_pre_cm2,
    vl_echo = vl_echo_post_au - vl_echo_pre_au,
    rf_csa = rf_csa_post_cm2 - rf_csa_pre_cm2,
    rf_echo = rf_echo_post_au - rf_echo_pre_au,
    volume_load_t = volume_load_total_kg / 1000
  )

leg_phenotype |>
  summarise(across(all_of(outcomes), function(x) signif(mean(x), 3)), .by = treatment)
```

## Fit the models

Both models are limpa fits (`dpcDE()`, so the `dpcQuant()` standard errors act as precision
weights, then `eBayes(robust = TRUE)`). `post` is 1 at T2 and 0 at T1; `x` is the leg's outcome,
centred on the mean leg.

| Term | What it does |
|---|---|
| `leg_id` | one baseline per leg, so only change within a leg counts |
| `treatment:post` | mean training change in each arm, so an arm difference cannot pose as a slope |
| `treatment:post:x` | extra protein change per unit of outcome, one slope per arm |
| `participant:post` | (within model) mean training change per participant |
| `bfr_post` | (within model) extra training change in the BFR leg |
| `post:x` | (within model) one slope, read only from a participant's two legs |
| `blood` | the blood index, as in `02_Differential` |

| Coefficient | Model | Question |
|---|---|---|
| BFR | arm | Does protein change track the outcome across BFR legs? |
| HLRT | arm | Does it track the outcome across HLRT legs? |
| difference | arm | Is the BFR slope different from the HLRT slope? |
| average | arm | Does it track the outcome on average over both arms? |
| within | within | Does the leg that changed more in the outcome change more in protein? |

The within model is not fitted for volume load: dose differs by arm by design, so the difference
between a participant's two legs is the arm difference. The paired design follows the limma User's
Guide (sections 9.4.1 and 9.5.3). BH adjustment runs within each outcome and coefficient.

```{r samples}
# The one leg without a T2 sample has no outcome change; its x is set to 0, which it never
# multiplies, because its only sample has post = 0.
samples <- targets |>
  mutate(
    leg_id = paste(participant, leg, sep = "_"), post = as.integer(timepoint == "T2"),
    bfr_post = post * (treatment == "BFR")
  ) |>
  left_join(select(leg_phenotype, leg_id, all_of(outcomes)), by = "leg_id") |>
  mutate(across(all_of(outcomes), function(x) coalesce(x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 0)))
models <- list(
  arm = ~ 0 + leg_id + treatment:post + treatment:post:x + blood,
  within = ~ 0 + leg_id + participant:post + bfr_post + post:x + blood
)
```

The four arm coefficients are contrasts of the two arm slopes.

```{r fits}
arm_weights <- cbind(
  BFR = c(1, 0), HLRT = c(0, 1), difference = c(1, -1), average = c(0.5, 0.5)
)
tidy_coefficient <- function(fit, coefficient) {
  topTable(fit, coef = coefficient, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "protein") |>
    transmute(
      protein, gene = coalesce(Genes, protein), slope = logFC, t, p = P.Value, fdr = adj.P.Val
    )
}
fits <- map(set_names(outcomes), function(outcome_name) {
  model_data <- mutate(samples, x = .data[[outcome_name]])
  arm_design <- model.matrix(models$arm, model_data)
  stopifnot(is.fullrank(arm_design))
  arm_contrast <- matrix(
    0, ncol(arm_design), ncol(arm_weights),
    dimnames = list(colnames(arm_design), colnames(arm_weights))
  )
  arm_contrast[c("treatmentBFR:post:x", "treatmentHLRT:post:x"), ] <- arm_weights
  arm_fit <- dpcDE(proteins, arm_design, plot = FALSE) |>
    contrasts.fit(arm_contrast) |>
    eBayes(robust = TRUE)
  tables <- map(set_names(colnames(arm_contrast)), function(coefficient) {
    tidy_coefficient(arm_fit, coefficient)
  })
  if (outcome_name != "volume_load_t") {
    within_design <- model.matrix(models$within, model_data)
    stopifnot(is.fullrank(within_design))
    within_fit <- eBayes(dpcDE(proteins, within_design, plot = FALSE), robust = TRUE)
    tables$within <- tidy_coefficient(within_fit, "post:x")
  }
  list(
    design = arm_design, contrasts = arm_contrast,
    results = list_rbind(tables, names_to = "coefficient")
  )
})
coefficient_order <- c("BFR", "HLRT", "difference", "average", "within")
results <- map(fits, "results") |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "outcome") |>
  arrange(match(outcome, outcomes), match(coefficient, coefficient_order), p)

results |>
  slice_min(p, n = 1, by = c(outcome, coefficient)) |>
  mutate(across(c(slope, t, p, fdr), function(x) signif(x, 3)))
```

Neither model has a participant block: a participant's two legs do not correlate in protein change
(median Spearman r between their BFR and HLRT legs, across proteins).

```{r leg-correlation}
delta <- values[, legs$T2] - values[, legs$T1]
colnames(delta) <- legs$leg_id
leg_r <- map_dbl(rownames(delta), function(id) {
  cor(delta[id, delta_pairs$BFR], delta[id, delta_pairs$HLRT], method = "spearman")
})
round(median(leg_r), 3)
```

## Summarise

One row per outcome and coefficient. Legs used counts the legs a slope is read from: every leg with
both samples for the arm model, and the legs of participants with both legs for the within model.
Chance alone gives about 152 nominal hits (5% of 3,042 proteins).

```{r summary}
legs_by_model <- c(
  arm = sprintf(
    "%d (BFR %d, HLRT %d)", nrow(legs), sum(legs$treatment == "BFR"),
    sum(legs$treatment == "HLRT")
  ),
  within = sprintf("%d (%d participants)", 2 * nrow(delta_pairs), nrow(delta_pairs))
)
covariates_by_model <- c(
  arm = "own baseline per leg; training change per arm; blood index",
  within = "own baseline per leg; training change per participant; extra BFR change; blood index"
)
outcome_summary <- results |>
  summarise(
    proteins = n(), nominal = sum(p < 0.05), bh = sum(fdr < 0.05), best_fdr = signif(min(fdr), 3),
    top_5 = paste0(head(gene, 5), if_else(head(slope, 5) > 0, " (+)", " (-)"), collapse = ", "),
    .by = c(outcome, coefficient)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = if_else(coefficient == "within", "within", "arm"),
    legs_used = unname(legs_by_model[model]),
    model_formula = map_chr(model, function(m) deparse1(models[[m]])),
    covariates = unname(covariates_by_model[model]),
    .after = coefficient
  ) |>
  select(-model)
select(outcome_summary, outcome, coefficient, nominal, bh, best_fdr, top_5)
```

## Rankings for gene set tests

`association_t` is what `03_Pathway_Enrichment/05_set_association` ranks on: one row per protein,
one column per ranking (`average_<outcome>`, `difference_<outcome>`), values the moderated t.
`association_designs` holds, per ranking, the arm design and the contrast vector, so fry there tests
the same coefficient.

```{r rankings}
rankings <- expand_grid(coefficient = c("average", "difference"), outcome = outcomes) |>
  mutate(ranking = paste(coefficient, outcome, sep = "_"))
association_t <- results |>
  inner_join(rankings, by = c("outcome", "coefficient")) |>
  select(protein, ranking, t) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = ranking, values_from = t) |>
  column_to_rownames("protein") |>
  as.matrix()
association_t <- association_t[rownames(proteins), ]
association_designs <- pmap(rankings, function(coefficient, outcome, ranking) {
  list(design = fits[[outcome]]$design, contrast = fits[[outcome]]$contrasts[, coefficient])
}) |>
  set_names(rankings$ranking)
```

## Figures

One page per outcome: the three smallest p for each coefficient. Arm coefficients plot each leg's
protein change against its outcome, with a line fitted in each arm; the within coefficient plots
what it tests, one point per participant, BFR minus HLRT for both.

```{r figure}
paired <- delta[, delta_pairs$BFR] - delta[, delta_pairs$HLRT]
walk(outcomes, function(outcome_name) {
  outcome_value <- set_names(leg_phenotype[[outcome_name]], legs$leg_id)
  leads <- results |>
    filter(outcome == outcome_name) |>
    slice_min(p, n = 3, by = coefficient, with_ties = FALSE)
  points <- pmap(leads, function(coefficient, protein, gene, t, p, fdr, ...) {
    panel <- sprintf(
      "%s: %s\nt %+.2f, p %s, q %s", coefficient, gene, t, signif(p, 2), signif(fdr, 2)
    )
    if (coefficient == "within") {
      tibble(
        panel, change = paired[protein, ],
        value = outcome_value[delta_pairs$BFR] - outcome_value[delta_pairs$HLRT],
        series = "BFR - HLRT"
      )
    } else {
      tibble(
        panel, change = delta[protein, ], value = leg_phenotype[[outcome_name]],
        series = legs$treatment
      )
    }
  }) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = unique(panel)))
  page <- ggplot(points, aes(change, value, colour = series, fill = series)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(BFR = "#B2182B", HLRT = "#2166AC", `BFR - HLRT` = "grey25"),
      aesthetics = c("colour", "fill"), name = NULL
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 3, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      x = "protein change, log2, T2 - T1", y = outcome_name,
      title = paste("Top leads per coefficient,", outcome_name)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
  pdf(
    file.path(stage, "b_reports", paste0("03_association_", outcome_name, ".pdf")),
    width = 8.27, height = 11.69
  )
  print(page)
  invisible(dev.off())
})
```

## Save results

The rankings and designs travel as rds, because a workbook round trip can change the last bit of a
double.

```{r write}
top_leads <- slice_min(results, p, n = 25, by = c(outcome, coefficient), with_ties = FALSE)
saveRDS(association_t, file.path(stage, "c_data", "association_t.rds"))
saveRDS(association_designs, file.path(stage, "c_data", "association_designs.rds"))
write_xlsx(
  list(outcomes = outcome_summary, top_leads = top_leads, associations = results),
  file.path(stage, "c_data", "03_protein_association.xlsx")
)
```
